notes: VAT standard rate 15% (NamRA). Bullion NOT relieved: the full text of the Value-Added Tax Act 10 of 2000 was searched - the words gold/precious/metal occur nowhere, including Schedules III (zero-rated), IV (exempt supplies) and V (exempt imports) - so bullion and silver take 15% in both forms. Duty null (SACU CET rates sit behind the interactive eTariff portal; no openable 7108 line).
